title: Teacher's Lounge Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Teacher's Lounge is a 4 BR / 3 BA / 12 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. Teacher’s Lounge is one of the most featured and beloved cottages in Seaside. It has everything you’ll need for a luxurious and comfortable getaway.
description_expanded: Description498 Forest Street1 KING, 2 QUEENS, BUNK ROOM (with 3 bunk beds, sleeps 6) 1 QUEEN SLEEPER SOFAPlease be advised that there is construction located south of this home between Seaside and Watercolor for Seaside improvements, we apologize for this inconvenience. Construction completion date is Jan. 2026. Welcome to Teacher’s Lounge in Seaside, FloridaTeacher’s Lounge is one of Seaside’s most beloved and frequently featured vacation cottages, offering the perfect blend of space, comfort, and classic coastal charm. This expansive 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom Seaside home comfortably accommodates up to 14 guests, making it an ideal choice for large families, group getaways, or multi-generational vacations along Florida’s Scenic Highway 30A.Open Living Spaces Made for GatheringStep inside to discover a bright, open-concept living area with soaring ceilings and an abundance of seating for everyone to relax together. Plush sofas, cozy chairs, and a queen sleeper sofa surround a large flat-screen TV—perfect for movie nights, game days, or winding down after a day at the beach. The open layout allows guests to stay connected whether lounging, dining, or preparing meals.Updated Kitchen & Dining for the Whole CrewThe living space flows seamlessly into a spacious dining area with seating for eight, complemented by a breakfast bar for four just across the way. The updated kitchen features stainless steel appliances, ample counter space, and everything needed for easy family meals. Just off the kitchen, a screened-in furnished porch overlooks the side yard and includes a hammock—an inviting spot for afternoon lounging or morning coffee.Comfortable Bedrooms Across Two LevelsThe first floor hosts a queen bedroom with a private ensuite bathroom, offering convenient access and privacy. Upstairs, three additional bedrooms await:A spacious queen bedroom with high ceilings and calming coastal tonesA king primary suite with a private bathroom and double vanityA custom bunk room featuring three built-in twin bunks, sleeping up to six guestsAn open-air second-floor porch provides treetop views and a peaceful place to unwind in the fresh coastal air.Outdoor Living & Resort-Style AmenitiesTeacher’s Lounge offers multiple outdoor spaces designed for enjoying Seaside’s sunshine, including first- and second-story balconies, an outdoor shower, and a charcoal grill conveniently located off the downstairs porch. Guests also enjoy on-site washer and dryer, plus access to Seaside’s fitness center, swimming pools, tennis courts, and pickleball courts.Prime Seaside LocationPerfectly situated near the family pool, neighborhood park, and just a short walk to Seaside’s private beach, Teacher’s Lounge delivers both convenience and classic Seaside charm. With generous living spaces, inviting porches, and an unbeatable location, this iconic cottage is a favorite guests return to year after year for unforgettable Seaside, Florida vacations.Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. 5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum WinterFEATURES1,901 square feetSeaside Private Residential Beach at East Ruskin Pavilion — the largest private residential beach on 30A5-minute, 352-yard walk to beach accessEast side of Seaside locationRelaxing rope hammockWasher and dryer on-siteOutdoor showerPeacock Alley Linens — Fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeDesignated parking spot located in front of the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts (court fees apply), 3 Pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote included with your stay featuring a complimentary bottle of wine and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking policy: Only 1 parking pass is issued for one-bedroom cottages and 2 parking passes for two-bedroom and larger homes. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit.No pets allowedSTR23-002046
